adaptation: Four real supplier-review agents run concurrent six-review batches in separate sandboxes over one persistent operations store. V16 connects the first three incident components from an empty start. A normal diagnostic creates a method-free agent probe. A method-capable real job's exact read creates a method-free operations access receipt, while real submissions identify that job's retired-record capability. The blocked requester must read both records before asking through undocumented manual write access; the capable reader must receive and answer the exact ask, and a fresh agent must read and use the method on a different review. No peer, probe, request, reply or method is simulated or seeded.
